headline: Sensex and Nifty aim to extend recovery as markets open for the week of October 12

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty are likely to extend their recovery after eight weeks of losses
The IT sector rally was led by a significant jump in TCS shares
Market recovery follows a period of pressure caused by RBI rate hikes and rising oil prices
Positive market sentiment followed a Friday rally where the Sensex gained nearly 900 points
whatHappening: Markets are opening for the week of October 12-16 following a sharp recovery
The government has unveiled the New Steel Policy Vision 2047 to boost output
Former Flipkart employees are seeking stock option liquidity from parent company Walmart
Geopolitical tensions are being monitored after a second attack on Riyadh Airport
summary: Indian markets are expected to open with positive momentum, aiming to extend the recovery seen last Friday after an eight-week losing streak. The IT sector is in focus following a rally led by TCS, while the Sensex and Nifty look to maintain levels above 22,500. Investors are also monitoring the new national steel policy and ongoing geopolitical developments in the Middle East.
